svg.text: Present your distributed system like a pro — and document it so another team can run and extend it.
Communicating it clearly is a senior skill — and it is graded.
STRUCTURE THE PITCH· a narrative that lands
“We used Kafka, Postgres, Docker, K8s v1.29…”
Just a list of tools — nobody remembers it
Tell the WHY behind each choice:
Why sync here and async there?
What did we reject? → point to the ADRs
One clear diagram — people remember the WHY.
What a new engineer needs to run & extend it.
Test: could another team run it without calling you?
PREPARE A DEMO THAT PROVES IT
A live demo beats 20 slides of architecture.
send a real request through the system
retries · saga · outbox do their job
Show working software first — explain second.
REAL-LIFE SCENARIO· great system, terrible pitch
Live demo: order → saved → kill → recover
COMMON MISTAKES→ how to fix them

g.text: Docs so anyone can run it

svg.text: Like selling a used car: a test drive first (demo), then why that engine (decisions), the owner’s manual (docs), and the honest scratches (lessons).
